summary: Enable bounded judging only after saving the chosen criteria; disable it at the end of the activity.

steps.title: Save your judgment first

steps.title: Write behavior-specific criteria
steps.body: Flag unrequested changes to preserved flights. Fewer flights alone is insufficient: a passenger may request a nonstop or one-way trip.

steps.title: Examine disagreements in Alignment
steps.body: Inspect the judge reason and turn context. A test experiment does not change the live criteria until saved.

steps.title: Keep native availability explicit

steps.output: Unavailable is not a negative label
